text: Onions and garlic are essential in many recipes. Start by chopping the onions and garlic finely, then add them to the pan and cook them over medium heat for a few minutes until they start to brown and release their flavor. This process is called browning and is one of the most important steps in preparing vegetables for cooking. Finally, season your dish with salt, pepper, and any other desired spices to bring out the flavors of the onions and garlic.
